title: Harmonized embedding model adoption policy + auto-deprecate safeguards
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Create a single, enforceable adoption policy for new embedding models plus an automated deprecation safety net. This ticket covers the policy, runtime hooks, telemetry signals, and the automation to mark and decommission stale or regressed model variants.

Why: We onboard new embedding variants frequently; without harmonized policy we see inconsistent tenant behavior, surprise cost spikes, and unclear rollback boundaries. We also want an automated, telemetry-driven guard so deprecated models don't remain in rotation indefinitely.

Scope:
- Policy: define required smoke/eval checks, cost/latency thresholds, and tenant opt-in gating for any new embedding model variant.
- Runtime hooks: prefix-based routing pins, model alias metadata, and per-tenant throttles to prevent noisy tenants from perturbing rollout metrics.
- Telemetry: introduce a similarity-drift signal (compare baseline and candidate embeddings on a rolling prompt set) and a latency/cost delta signal.
- Auto-deprecate automation: CRON job + rule engine that flags variants with N-day zero adoption, or >X% quality regression, or >Y% latency regression. Flagged variants go to a staged 'retire-warning' state and then decommissioned after manual review.
- Rollout policy: percentage-based traffic ramp with latency-aware routing and automatic fallback to a compatible quantized variant if latency SLOs break.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Policy doc merged to Confluence: "Embedding Adoption Policy" with checklist required for model onboarding.
2) New runtime metadata fields implemented: model_alias, canary_percent, tenant_pin_allowed (boolean).
3) Similarity-drift telemetry pipeline and dashboard capturing weekly rolling comparisons across tenants.
4) Automation engine can mark variants as retire-warning and transition to deprecated after a configurable window; actions recorded in audit log.
5) E2E test covering canary ramp -> surge in latency -> automatic fallback to quantized variant.

Non-goals: full UI for self-serve retirements (Console work will follow), market-facing communication templates (PM will handle).
